items: NSE shareholding filings (Dec 2025 → Sep 2026, 3 quarters): companies name every fund house holding 1%+. For 5,031 such positions named in consecutive filings, the change in shares we found matched the company's filing within 1% of the position in 93% of cases; for the 2,929 positions that moved 2% or more, the direction matched in 100% and the size within 10% in 89%.

Scheme by scheme against AMFI NAVs (Oct 2025 – Sep 2026, 463 active schemes a month): our buying plus the change in cash came within ±1% of the money that went into the scheme (from its NAV and AUM) for 91% of schemes on average; correlation 0.96. The gap is mostly dividends the funds received, largest in July–September.

Prices: for every holding, value ÷ quantity was compared with the NSE close on the portfolio date (after bonus and split adjustment): 99.98% of 916,595 holdings agree within 3%, and every fund-house month is at least 99.4%.
